workspace_policy: preallocate equivalent score/output workspace before timing; FP32 softmax temporary and FP16 probabilities must be accounted consistently; persistent reuse is allowed only symmetrically or when semantic materialization is eliminated
stream_policy: all vendor GEMM and custom local kernels use the current PyTorch CUDA stream; no hidden default stream or per-call device synchronization
future_orchestration: framework-owned host adapter calls vendor GEMMs and an explicit local softmax stage; a raw softmax-kernel ABI is preferred over a host function that secretly owns a cuBLAS handle
